subthemes.name: Workload & boards pressure
items: The syllabus for my class feels too much to handle.
I worry about boards (or board-pattern tests) a lot.
I feel tests and submissions keep piling up together.
I can't tell how I'll finish what I have pending.
I feel I need to study longer than I actually can.
There is more homework than hours in my day.
I feel pressured to cover tuition work on top of school work.
I feel I'll never catch up to where I should be.

subthemes.name: Study avoidance & procrastination
items: I keep putting off starting my study for the day.
I open my books and end up on my phone instead.
I avoid the subject I find hardest.
I feel stuck when I look at my pending list.
I feel scared to start work I don't know how to do.
I pretend to study but drift on social media.
I start late on tasks I know are important.
I feel the thought of starting is harder than doing.

subthemes.name: Concentration & study habits
items: I find it hard to concentrate while studying.
I re-read the same page without understanding.
My mind wanders when I try to focus.
I feel mentally tired by the time I finish school.
I forget what I just read or revised.
I need more breaks than I used to to get through study.
I feel I don't have a good way to study.

subthemes.name: Marks pressure & academic self-worth
items: I worry about my marks even on ordinary days.
One bad mark can ruin my mood for days.
I feel scared of being scolded for poor results.
I feel my marks decide how my parents see me.
I compare my marks with classmates and feel behind.
I feel I have to be a top scorer to feel okay.
Even after doing well, I immediately worry about the next test.

subthemes.name: Parental expectations & pressure
items: My parents expect more from me than I can give.
I feel my parents only care about my marks.
I feel scared of disappointing my parents.
I feel my parents' mood depends on my results.
I feel my parents keep pushing me harder.
I feel my parents don't ask how I'm feeling, only how I did.
I feel I'm living someone else's plan more than my own.
I feel my worth at home depends on how I perform.

subthemes.name: Comparison with siblings, cousins, peers
items: My parents compare me with my sibling or cousins.
I feel my sibling gets treated better than me.
Relatives say things that make me feel smaller.
I'm compared with the 'topper' in my class at home.
I feel I'm never as good as the person my parents hold up as an example.
I feel I have to catch up with someone I shouldn't be measured against.
I feel invisible when a sibling does well.

subthemes.name: Home environment & tension
items: My home feels tense right now.
My parents argue, and it bothers me.
I feel caught between family members.
I avoid being at home when I can.
Someone at home is going through a tough time and it affects me.
I feel lonely at home even with people around.
I don't feel I can relax at home.
I feel I have to behave carefully at home.

subthemes.name: Avoiding family conversations
items: I don't tell my parents when something is upsetting me.
I hide my real feelings so I don't worry them.
I avoid conversations about my future with my parents.
I feel I can't tell my parents what I actually want.
I say 'I'm fine' at home when I'm not.
I avoid family dinners when I'm low.
I feel I need to look okay all the time at home.

subthemes.name: Fitting in with peers
items: I feel I have to act a certain way to fit in.
I feel I can't be the real me around my friends.
I worry about being judged by my classmates.
I feel left behind when my friends talk about things I don't know.
I feel I don't belong in my current friend circle.
I feel I have to change how I dress or speak to be liked.
I feel invisible in my class group.
I feel I don't match up with the popular kids.

subthemes.name: Peer pressure around choices & behaviour
items: I feel pressured to do things I don't want to (smoking, drinking, pranks).
I feel scared to say no to my friends.
I go along with things that make me uncomfortable.
I feel my friends decide what I should like or do.
I'm nervous about my friends' reaction if I act differently.
I feel I can't tell adults about pressure from friends.
I've done things I regret because of friends.

subthemes.name: Group belonging & inclusion
items: I feel left out of my class WhatsApp or online group.
I don't have one friend I can count on.
I spend breaks or lunch alone sometimes when I don't want to.
I feel I'm losing a friendship that mattered to me.
I miss friends I used to be close to.
I feel no one would notice if I didn't show up.
I feel I have to earn my place in a group every day.
I feel my friends have moved on without me.

subthemes.name: Teasing, bullying & exclusion
items: Some kids tease or make fun of me.
I feel picked on at school or online.
Someone close said something that really hurt me.
I had a fight with a classmate that is not resolved.
I feel scared of going to school because of someone.
I feel I'm often the butt of jokes in my group.
Someone is spreading things about me behind my back.

subthemes.name: Self-worth & 'not good enough'
items: I feel I'm not good enough even when I'm doing well.
I'm really hard on myself when I make a mistake.
I replay my mistakes in my head for days.
I notice my flaws more than my strengths.
I feel I disappoint myself regularly.
I expect myself to be perfect at things.
One bad result feels like proof I'm not capable.
I feel I don't deserve good things that happen to me.

subthemes.name: Body image & puberty
items: I feel uncomfortable with how my body looks.
I compare my body with classmates and feel bad.
I feel embarrassed about changes in my body.
I avoid photos because I don't like how I look.
I feel my face / skin / weight isn't okay.
I feel I don't look the way I 'should' at my age.
I avoid certain clothes because of how I feel about my body.

subthemes.name: Confidence in my abilities
items: I doubt I can handle what is ahead of me.
I feel smaller or less confident than I used to.
I second-guess decisions I have already made.
I avoid speaking up in class because I feel I'll be wrong.
I don't try new things because I'm scared of failing.
I feel other students are more capable than me.
I feel I can't trust my own choices.
I feel I don't know what I'm actually good at.

subthemes.name: Self-identity & who I'm becoming
items: I feel confused about who I really am right now.
I feel I've changed and I'm not sure who I am.
I feel I'm acting a role I don't fully believe in.
I feel lost about what I actually like or want.
I feel pulled in different directions by school, friends and family.
I feel I have to hide parts of who I am.
I feel I don't recognise myself lately.

subthemes.name: Overwhelm & distress
items: I feel overwhelmed and can't shake it off.
Small problems feel much bigger than they should.
I feel I'm on the edge of tears often.
I feel angry or snappy with people.
Stress symptoms spill into my sleep or appetite.
I feel I can barely keep up with everyday things.
I feel I'm about to burst sometimes.
Even small changes to my plan feel like too much.

subthemes.name: Anxiety & worry
items: I feel on edge or anxious without a clear reason.
My heart races when I'm not doing anything active.
I worry about things that haven't happened yet.
I imagine bad things happening.
I feel restless and can't sit still.
I replay things that went wrong at school.
I feel scared of making mistakes in front of others.

subthemes.name: Low mood & motivation
items: I feel low or unmotivated even when nothing specific is wrong.
Things I usually enjoy feel flat.
I feel heavy when I wake up.
I cry more easily than usual, or feel like crying.
I feel disconnected from my day as it passes.
Small decisions feel harder than they used to.
I feel like I'm just going through the motions.
I feel less interested in things I was looking forward to.

subthemes.name: Avoidant / escape coping
items: I use scrolling, gaming or snacks to switch off feelings.
I binge-watch content late into the night to avoid thinking.
I overeat or lose interest in food when I'm stressed.
I distract myself rather than deal with what's bothering me.
I hide in my room when I'm sad.
I avoid people when I'm low.
I get grumpy with my family instead of saying what's wrong.

subthemes.name: Screen time & overuse
items: I spend more time on screens than I'd like to.
I lose track of time on my phone.
I feel bad after long phone sessions, but I keep going.
I can't put my phone away when I know I should.
I use my phone the first thing in the morning and last thing at night.
I feel restless without my phone.
I check my phone during class / study, even when I shouldn't.
I pick up my phone without even realising I did.

subthemes.name: Social media comparison
items: Social media makes me feel I'm not doing enough.
I compare my life to what I see online.
I feel other people's lives look better than mine.
I feel my body / looks / lifestyle isn't 'Instagram-worthy'.
I feel pressure to look / behave like influencers I follow.
I stop posting because of how I think it will be judged.
I compare likes and follower counts with friends.
I feel my friends have more fun than I do, based on their posts.

subthemes.name: Online conflicts & hurtful content
items: I've had an online argument that still bothers me.
Someone screenshotted or shared something I said, and it hurt me.
I've seen hurtful messages or comments about me online.
I feel my online presence is being watched or judged.
I've been removed from a group or blocked by someone close.
I come across content online that upsets me (fights, scary news, trolls).
I feel pressure to respond quickly to messages.

subthemes.name: FOMO & online social pressure
items: I feel left out when I see friends hanging out online.
I check my phone to make sure I'm not missing anything.
I feel I have to be available online all the time.
I feel I'll miss something important if I log off for a day.
I feel pressure to post stories or updates regularly.
I feel my online identity has to match a certain image.
I feel bad after a day without social media, like I missed things.
